text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm compiling the cross-team checklist for the Catalyst private pilot. Need to lock launch criteria + sequencing. Who can join a 15-min sync?
sanjay: I can — runtime. What's the main blocker?
maria: Main open items: HSM/KMS approvals, prewarm capacity, quantized model build & validation, canary rollout gates, and privacy audit. Also need perf SLO targets (p50/p90/p95).
olga: Security: HSM integration still needs compliance review, ETA Wed EOD. We also need a list of required logs for auditors and retention policy.
anita: Eng-infra: We can reserve 2x prewarm capacity for week 1, but we need routing rules for burst and a plan for GPU slot eviction. Who owns routing config?
ryan: Product infra: I'll own the routing + feature flag. Need API schema freeze and a canonical test prompt set by Tues.
sanjay: Runtime: we can enable prefix caching and a quantized variant to cut cost, but quantized model needs a 2-day validation/QA window. Also want to run kernel selection on sample traces.
maria: Proposed gating order: 1) Security signoff (HSM + audit), 2) API/schema freeze, 3) perf/runbook load tests, 4) canary (10%) with monitoring, 5) full rollout. Agree?
olga: Agree. Add: mandatory rollback plan, and fallback to hosted model variant if private pipeline fails.
anita: Also add infra alert thresholds: GPU util >80%, queue latency >200ms, token errors >1% -> auto-scale and page.
ryan: I'll add alerts to the runbook and create canary flags in LaunchDarkly. @maria can you drop the eval prompts?
maria: Dropping draft prompt set here: https://docs.internal/catalyst/evals — aim for ~50 golden prompts covering edge cases. I'll finish by EOD today.
sanjay: I'll schedule perf runs tomorrow morning (seq len mix + burst). Need test creds for KMS and a test bucket for artifacts — @olga can you share?
olga: Shared a test key to #secretops and granted a temp service account. I'll also upload compliance checklist and required log fields.
deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled: canary-001 -> 10% traffic for 12h. Waiting on security approval from @olga to start.
maria: Action items recap: maria: finalize prompt set; ryan: feature flag + routing config; sanjay: perf runs + quant QA; anita: reserve capacity + alerting; olga: KMS test creds + compliance docs. Target: if all done by Thu EOD we can canary Fri morning. Anyone object?
everyone: :thumbsup:
